items.title: Spiral Disc Lattice DXF Panel for CNC Wall Screens
items.description: Free for personal projects, overlapping spiral discs built from curved lens-shaped segments create a hypnotic, almost fish-scale texture across the panel's core, framed by ornate scrollwork corners and a small dotted circle accent. The optical rhythm of the spirals makes this a strong choice for a modern statement piece.

items.title: Damask Fan Tail DXF Panel for Laser-Cut Wall Screens
items.description: A dramatic fan-shaped burst rises from the base of the panel, its ribbed feather-like segments cutting through a dense floral damask backdrop. The fan silhouette reads almost like a peacock tail or rising sun, giving this piece a bold, celebratory focal point distinct from the smaller repeating damask patterns elsewhere in the set.

items.title: Kaleidoscope Star Diamond DXF Panel for Ornamental Screens
items.description: Faceted diamonds radiate outward from central star points, repeating in a kaleidoscope-like mirrored grid. The crystalline, jewel-box geometry suits ornamental interior screens, cabinet inserts, and light-filtering room dividers.
